name: morning-briefing
author: sparkleware
description: Daily morning briefing — date, day-of-week, current weather (wttr.in), and a sparkly closer. No API key required.
long_description_md:
## What it does

A small, friendly skill that prints a one-screen briefing each morning: today's date and weekday, current weather pulled from wttr.in, and a closing line that varies by day-of-week.

Optional `${var}` overrides the location (e.g. `${var}="Jakarta"` or `${var}="Tokyo"`). Default uses wttr.in's IP-geo (accurate within ~50 km).

## Why

The terminal can feel cold at 7am. This skill makes it feel a tiny bit more like a thoughtful assistant — without overpromising. No alerts, no notifications, no obligations. Just a short, friendly hello.

## How it works

Three sections, ≤8 lines total:
1. Date + day-of-week from `date -u`
2. Weather from `curl https://wttr.in/<location>?format=4&M` — one-line metric summary
3. Closing line — deterministic by day-of-week (seven preset tones, one per weekday)

Graceful fallback if wttr.in is unreachable. Optional log append to `memory/logs/morning-briefing.log` for searchable archive.
